## Install on Windows

1. Download {setup-name} from this release and run it. It installs for your Windows account only, without an admin prompt, and adds VRCFaceTracking to the Start menu.
2. Start VRCFaceTracking. If you haven't installed your tracking module before, get it from the Module Registry tab.
3. Launch VRChat with OSC enabled. Once the module is receiving data, the Home tab shows it as active.

Setup also registers this copy with SteamVR. If an older copy you extracted by hand had "Start with SteamVR" turned on, SteamVR starts the installed copy from now on.

To run it without installing, extract {zip-name} anywhere except `Program Files` and run `VRCFaceTracking.exe`.

Settings and installed modules are kept in `%AppData%\VRCFaceTracking`, the same folder the Steam build uses. An existing setup carries over.
